function.description: Execute a REAL cross-chain bridge via Relay. SPENDS FUNDS: it signs and broadcasts on the source chain, and it requires approval before it runs. REQUIRES a fresh matching BridgeQuoteRelay FIRST on Relay; a Khalani quote cannot authorize it. Resolve fromToken and toToken separately with TokenFind on their exact chains. For an EVM token, call TokenFind with exactly one target chain and continue only when mutationReady is true. Ambiguous, provider-capped, or metadata-unreadable results are not executable identities. If the swap pair is already known, prefer its exact base or quote token address and use TokenFind to validate that address on the target chain. TokenFind reads symbol and decimals from the contract, never provider list metadata. Read decimals from a contract-verified TokenFind candidate on the exact source chain. A provider-list decimal is not signing authority, and a raw amount without contract decimals is unsafe. `amountRaw` is in RAW base units (wei/lamports). The approval card must show each exact chain, token contract, contract-read symbol and decimals, plus the human and atomic source amounts before signing. Returns the source transaction hash and the order id to follow with BridgeStatus; failed and pending attempts are recorded and shown with chain + tx hash + explorer link, same as confirmed ones. Khalani is the primary bridge route - reach for Relay when Khalani does not cover the route (it is the only venue for Robinhood Chain) or its quote failed for a routing reason.
function.name: BridgeExecuteRelay

amountRaw.description: Amount in raw atomic units of fromToken (e.g. USDC has 6 decimals, so 1 USDC = "1000000"). Read decimals from a contract-verified TokenFind candidate on the exact source chain. A provider-list decimal is not signing authority, and a raw amount without contract decimals is unsafe.

fromToken.description: Source token address, or native ETH/native.

recipient.description: Destination recipient override (defaults to your dest-chain wallet).

slippageBps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points for the destination-side fill (1 bps = 0.01%). Higher tolerance widens the worst-case received amount on the destination chain. When a bridge quote fails or fills keep expiring, re-quote with a higher value rather than retrying the same one. Vex caps it at 1000 (10%) and rejects anything above rather than clamping.

toToken.description: Destination token address, or native ETH/native.
